head: Meta Muse Charm price may be 300 dollars with free Verizon 5G
dek: Meta plans to sell its Muse Charm, a pocket device for talking to its Muse AI agent, for 300 dollars with up to 12 months of free Verizon 5G data, according to The Information, citing one person familiar with the plans. Meta hasn't confirmed the price or the Verizon offer.
details: The Charm has a touchscreen of about two inches and built-in 5G, and Muse can send email, book travel and fill out forms. Meta showed it in September, when Reuters reported it was expected to ship in December; there's no exact release date. A Meta spokesperson said only that the company will have more to share soon.
where: Not on sale yet; price and data offer reported, not announced
means: If you've been waiting to see what the Charm costs, this is the first reported price, but it could still change before Meta announces it.
todo: Nothing to do yet; wait for Meta's own price and release date before deciding.
